14 days Kerala and Karnataka wildlife tour

Kochi · Periyar · Munnar · Ooty · Nagarhole · Coorg · Bandipur · 14 days

14 days South India tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

A two-week loop through the forests of the Western Ghats — Periyar, Eravikulam, Nagarhole and Bandipur — with tea hills and Coorg in between.

Duration
14 days, 13 nights

What makes this one worth it

  • Boat safari on Periyar Lake
  • Eravikulam National Park and the Nilgiri tahr
  • Jeep safaris in Nagarhole and Bandipur
  • Coorg's coffee hills, Abbey Falls and Raja's Seat
  • Mysore Palace and Chamundi Hill on the way

Your day by day

  1. Day 1

    Arrive in Kochi

    Airport pickup and check-in.

  2. Day 2

    Kochi, then to Periyar

    The synagogue, Dutch Palace, St. Francis Church and the fishing nets in the morning, then four hours to Periyar.

  3. Day 3

    Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary

    A boat on Periyar Lake in the early morning and a guided nature walk.

  4. Day 4

    Periyar to Munnar

    Three hours into the tea hills. The Tea Museum and a working tea factory.

  5. Day 5

    Eravikulam National Park

    A morning in Eravikulam for the Nilgiri tahr and the high grasslands, the afternoon free.

  6. Day 6

    Munnar to Ooty

    A long, scenic drive across the hills into the Nilgiris. Ooty Lake in the evening.

  7. Day 7

    Ooty to Nagarhole

    Through Mudumalai to a jungle lodge at the edge of Nagarhole.

  8. Day 8

    Nagarhole National Park

    A morning jeep safari, birdwatching from the lodge and a guided nature walk.

  9. Day 9

    Nagarhole to Coorg

    Three hours to Madikeri. Raja's Seat, the fort, Omkareshwara temple and Abbey Falls.

  10. Day 10

    A free day in Coorg

    Coffee estates, viewpoints and markets at your own pace.

  11. Day 11

    Coorg to Bandipur via Mysore

    Mysore Palace and Chamundeshwari temple on the way to Bandipur.

  12. Day 12

    Bandipur National Park

    A jeep safari in Bandipur, with time for birdwatching and a walk around the lodge.

  13. Day 13

    Back to Kochi

    The longest day — about nine hours back to Kochi. An early start and a comfortable car.

  14. Day 14

    Departure

    Transfer to Kochi airport.

Questions people ask

How long is this Kerala wildlife tour package?
The tour runs for 14 days and 13 nights. It covers Cochin, Periyar, Munnar, Ooty, Nagarhole, Madikeri, Mysore and Bandipur.
What animals can I see during this Kerala wildlife safari?
Elephants, gaur, sambar deer and langurs are commonly seen, with a chance of tigers in Periyar and Bandipur. Nagarhole is especially known for its large elephant herds and rich birdlife.
Is a boat ride included at Periyar Tiger Reserve?
Yes, a boat ride on Periyar lake is part of the itinerary. It is a peaceful way to watch elephants, deer and birds along the shoreline.
Can I customise this itinerary?
Yes. We can add nights, include places like Wayanad or the Alleppey backwaters, or change the hotel category; just tell us your preferences and we will tailor the plan.
Do I need a visa?
Most travellers from the US, UK, Canada, UAE and Mexico need a valid Indian visa. Please check the current requirements on the official Indian visa portal before booking.
What is the best season for a Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary tour?
October to April brings cooler, drier weather and better wildlife viewing. In the hotter months elephants often gather near water, which can make sightings easier, while some safari zones may close during the monsoon.
Is this tour suitable for elderly travellers or families with kids?
Yes. The pace is gentle, drives are broken up in a comfortable private AC car, hotels are handpicked, and safaris are guided, so it works well for seniors and children alike.
How many safaris are included in the Bandipur National Park section?
One jeep safari at Bandipur is included. Extra safaris at Bandipur or Nagarhole can be arranged locally at an additional cost.
Are inner line permits or special approvals needed?
No special permits are needed on this route beyond a standard Indian tourist visa. We arrange the forest entry passes for your safaris.
What should I pack?
Bring light cotton clothes for the plains and a warm layer for the hill towns of Munnar and Ooty. Comfortable shoes, sunscreen, insect repellent and a good camera for wildlife are also worth packing.
